name: @mcbuild/renderer
description: The Camera / Renderer service: turns extracted region data (.schem / compact JSON) into multi-angle PNGs for LLM vision critique. This package is the "Eyes" of the four-role architecture (see BUILD_ENGINE_PLAN.md §1.3, §6). Skeleton status: the camera framing math is real and tested; the mesher, asset extraction, schem loading, and Puppeteer host are documented stubs.

dependencyRationale.@mcbuild/protocol: Shared language-neutral contract (§8). Region / Vec3 / .schem-layout types eventually live here; declared as a workspace dep so the renderer speaks the same vocabulary as the plugin + engine. Not installed yet — types in src/types.ts are self-contained until protocol lands.
dependencyRationale.prismarine-nbt: Parse/serialize the Sponge .schem (v3) NBT payload the plugin's captureRegion emits (palette map + varint Data array + tile-entity NBT + DataVersion). See src/schem-loader.ts and §7.3.
dependencyRationale.puppeteer: PRIMARY renderer path (§6.2, §11 #3). Drives headless Chromium, whose SwiftShader software WebGL runs three.js with no native GL build — Windows-native, the whole reason this beats headless-gl. See src/puppeteer-host.ts.
dependencyRationale.sharp: OPTIONAL. Post-process/normalize the screenshot buffer (crop to 768x768, strip PNG timestamp/metadata for the byte-stable determinism contract of §6.3). Puppeteer can also screenshot PNG directly; sharp is the determinism/normalize belt-and-suspenders.
dependencyRationale.three: The renderer core run INSIDE the headless-Chromium page (prismarine-viewer's / deepslate's rendering approach, §6.2). @mcbuild/renderer holds the camera math as three.js-compatible config; the in-page harness builds the scene from the mesher's output.
dependencyRationale.@types/three: Type definitions for three so the camera config + (future) mesher are type-checked against real three.js camera/frustum shapes.
